phase_name: Regression coverage in the existing suite

objectives.description: Add build_repo_tracked_ignored fixture helper and U1-U6 regression cases to test-git-commit-scoped.sh
Run negative control (stub pre-fix guard in a /tmp scratch copy), confirm U1/U2/U3/U5 FAIL and U4 still correctly refuses; confirm full suite green on real tree; shellcheck clean

notes: Negative control (stubbed pre-fix guard in /tmp/claude-neg-control-325, never touching the real source-store file): U1, U2, U3, U5 FAILED as expected (the exact V7 regression -- advisory-exit treated as hard failure, commit aborted). U4 (genuine out-of-repo-pathspec failure) still correctly refused under the pre-fix script too (rc=2, no commit) -- only the assertion's literal message-text match failed (old script emits 'WARNING: git add failed...', new script emits 'ERROR:...genuinely unstaged'), proving the fix does not regress the hard-failure case while improving its diagnostic wording. U6 (directory pathspec + ephemeral excludes) passed under both scripts, as expected since that scenario never triggers the V7 advisory path. Full suite on the real tree: 32 passed, 0 failed.

Used /etc/passwd instead of the plan's illustrative /etc/hostname for the out-of-repo pathspec in U4 -- more portably present across Linux distros/containers; same out-of-repo-absolute-path mechanism the plan names as 'such as'.
